description: Is one country included? Pass its name in any language or its ISO-2 code (map a city to its country first). Returns included true/false; when included, the server price of the european eSIM at the asked (or default) data size and its buy_url. Countries such as Switzerland or Serbia come back included=false.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

country.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Italy", "Italia", "it".

gb.description: The data pool in GB, ONE pool for every included country, valid 90 days: 3, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100. Omit = 10 GB. Not sure? Call recommend_config.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, it. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

name: check_country
title: Is a country included?
